description: Discard schedule 'one from four races scored, two from eight': with four races scored, each boat's worst score is excluded, and the lead changes.
citation: RRS 2025-2028 A2.1: 'Each boat's series score shall, subject to rule 90.3(b), be the total of her race scores excluding her worst score', and the notice of race may provide 'that a specified number of scores will be excluded if a specified number of races are scored'. Four races reaches this schedule's first threshold, so one score is excluded. A4 scores the places.
working: Four races scored reaches the first threshold, so the discard count is 1.
R1-R3 as in the below-threshold vector. R4: B 1, D 2, C 3, A 4.
A 1,3,1,4: gross 9, worst 4 (R4) excluded, net 5. B 2,1,4,1: gross 8, 4 (R3) excluded, net 4.
C 3,4,3,3: gross 13, 4 (R2) excluded, net 9. D 4,2,2,2: gross 10, 4 (R1) excluded, net 6.
Every boat's worst score is unique. No two nets are equal: B, A, D, C. At three races A led; the first discard puts B ahead.
